Meta Phone Screen E4 US
Just had my interview couple hours ago. 
I have 2.5 YOE and got reached out by Meta recruiter couple weeks ago to schedule phone screen, I took 3 weeks for studying during my free time. 
The interview was 45 min long, interviewer did breif intro and we moved into coding questions: 
https://leetcode.com/problems/sum-root-to-leaf-numbers/description/
No follow up, just asked time complexity and space complexity (if using recursion make sure to mention call stack needed for recursive functions)
https://leetcode.com/problems/valid-word-abbreviation/description/
No follow ups for second one, solved using two pointers. 
Finished with 15 mins left so we spent remaining time in questions I had to interviewer. 
Around 30 mins after finishing phone screen got update from recruiter that I passed into the onsite round, will have a call in couple days for getting sorted all details. 

This is gonna be my first system design interview, is it crazy thnking about passing it in the very first try? I've heard comparing to coding interviews SD ones are more difficult.

sources.passage:
Meta Phone Screen
My phone screen happened with meta and I was moving to next round. I was asked two questions and I was able to solve both of them efficiently and able to explain by dry running the code .

First Question : Question based on matrix and identify whether all the elements in each diagonal are same 
Second questions: related to product of sparse vectors 
Both of the questions are meta tagged . Discussed about the time and space complexeties and asked follow up questions realted on how I handle when the size of the matrix is very large . Asked a follow up question related to second question: How will I store the sparse vectors using hashmap and vectors and which one is better in what situation and how would the memory access pattern looks like in case of hashmap and vectors

title: Dot Product of Two Sparse Vectors

reported.text: Dot product of two sparse vectors; follow-up on hashmap vs vector-of-pairs storage and memory access patterns.

Meta | SE | Technical phone screening | March 2026 
Just gave my technical phone screening round for Meta SE position , and it went like this.
He first asked two behavioural questions regarding my projects.
Then he asked two question for which i had to write the code and dry run it, also explain time complexities.
Q1: https://leetcode.com/problems/simplify-path/description/
Q2: https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-level-sum-of-a-binary-tree/description/

One thing i noticed is that he was very specific about time that i will get for each question behavioral and technical both. Waiting for the results.

title: Maximum Level Sum of a Binary Tree

reported.text: Phone screen: return the smallest level of a binary tree whose node values have the maximum sum.
